description: This file defines the EnumCasesFunction class, which is a custom Twig node expression for handling enum cases within Twig templates. It extends FunctionExpression and provides logic to compile enum case handling, including validation of arguments and usage of enum methods.

classes.name: EnumCasesFunction
classes.description: A custom Twig expression node for handling enum cases, which extends Twig's FunctionExpression to compile enum-related syntax within templates.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the enum cases function, validating arguments and outputting the appropriate PHP code to invoke enum cases.
